questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答 因为}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}(-1)^{n-1}u_{n}=u_{1}-u_{2}+u_{3}-u_{4}+\cdots+(-1)^{n-1}u_{n}+\cdots+u_{2n-1}-u_{2n}+\cdots\\&\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}(-1)^{n-1}u_{n}=u_{1}+u_{3}+\cdots+\cdots+u_{2n-1}+\cdots-u_{2}-u_{4}-\cdots-u_{2n}-\cdots=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}u_{2n-1}-\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}u_{2n}=2^{\omega}\\&\text{所以}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}u_{2n}=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}u_{2n-1}-2=5-2=3,\text{故}\omega\\&\quad\quad\quad\quad\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}u_{n}=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}u_{2n-1}+\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}u_{2n}=5+3=8,\omega\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{若级数为} \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (\sqrt{n+2}-2 \sqrt{n+1}+\sqrt{n})\text{，则其和是} [ \quad] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\sqrt{n+2}-2\sqrt{n+1}+\sqrt{n}=(\sqrt{n+2}-\sqrt{n+1})-(\sqrt{n+1}-\sqrt{n})=\frac{1}{\sqrt{n+2}+\sqrt{n+1}}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{n+1}+\sqrt{n}},\\&S_{n}=\sum_{k=1}^{n}(\frac{1}{\sqrt{k+2}}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{k+1}}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{k+1}+\sqrt{k}})=\frac{1}{\sqrt{n+2}+\sqrt{n+1}}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}+1},\\&S=\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}S_{n}=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}+1}=1-\sqrt{2}.\end{aligned}
